title: View Diff of Changes in a File
trigger: User wants to review what changed in a file against the previous commit

steps.action: In the File Explorer, modified files are marked with an M indicator and show git coloring (typically orange or blue)
Click the modified file to open it in File Viewer
The file displays with syntax highlighting; if it is a git repository, the File Viewer can show the diff against HEAD (the specific UI for toggling this is app-internal)
Alternatively, in the source control panel, click a changed file to see its diff displayed in the panel itself

outcome: The file's diff is displayed in the File Viewer, highlighting added and removed lines
